## Mehhcode Project Research Summary

### Project Purpose & Architecture

Mehhcode is an AI coding agent workspace — a command-line tool that orchestrates LLM interactions with file editing, shell execution, and tool use. The primary implementation is a **pure Rust Cargo workspace** (`edition = "2021"`, 10 crates) located under `crates/`. A TypeScript reference implementation exists separately under `packages/` (referenced in docs and `.gitignore`, but **not present in this checkout** — confirmed by `OPTIMIZE_REPORT.md` which states "No TypeScript packages/ directory exists in this checkout"). The architecture ports TS behavior to Rust with an emphasis on behavioral parity.

---

## 1. Root AGENTS.md — Key Development Rules

- **Conciseness**: Keep answers short, no emojis, no fluff, technical prose only. Define jargon before using it.
- **TypeScript strictness**: No `any` unless absolutely necessary. `@ts-ignore` banned, `@ts-expect-error` requires same-line reason, no `as any`, no disabling lint rules. Use only erasable TS syntax (`erasableSyntaxOnly`).
- **Error handling**: Let errors propagate (`throw` in TS, `Result`/`?` in Rust). No silent swallowing, no `.ok()`, no `unwrap_or_default()` without recovery strategy. Security checks fail closed, never open.
- **Trust boundaries**: Validate unknown input once at decided boundaries (CLI args, wire/API payloads, schema, I/O); pass typed values inward.
- **Imports**: No inline/dynamic imports (`await import()`). Top-level imports only.
- **Testing**: Prove new tests fail (`RED`) before applying fix. Keep test logic flat, avoid tautological assertions. Aim edits at root causes; stop after 2 consecutive failed fix attempts.
- **Git**: Never `git add -A`, `git reset --hard`, `git push --force`. Stage explicit paths only. Commit format: `{feat,fix,docs,refactor,chore}[(scope)]: <ASCII subject>`.

---

## 2. TypeScript Packages (`packages/`)

**Status**: The `packages/` directory does not exist in this checkout. It is referenced as a separate TS reference checkout (`karmavn/Mehhcode@ts-reference`) for porting parity work. Per AGENTS.md and `OPTIMIZE_REPORT.md`, packages would include: `ai`, `agent`, `coding-agent`, `tui`, `mcp`, `codemode`, `schema`, `telemetry`. Some porting annotations exist in Rust source (e.g., `crates/mehh-tui/src/fuzzy.rs` says "ported from TypeScript `packages/tui/src/fuzzy.ts`"), but no TS source is present here to inspect.

---

## 3. Rust Crates (`crates/`)

| Crate | Top-level src files | Responsibility |
|-------|-------------------|----------------|
| `mehh-ai` | `lib.rs` (modules: catalog, faux, overflow, retry, stream, streaming_json, transform_messages, types, unicode, validation, anthropic, azure_openai, bedrock, google, mistral, oauth, openai, openai_responses, sse) | LLM provider integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Azure, Bedrock), message transformation, model catalog, streaming, faux provider for testing. |
| `mehh-agent` | `lib.rs` (modules: agent, agent_loop, types) | Core agent abstraction: `AgentTool` trait, agent loop, session types. |
| `mehh-tools` | `lib.rs` (modules: analyze, bash, core, edit, file_mutation_queue, find, grep, ls, powershell, read, undo_edit, write) | File and shell tools (read, write, edit, bash, grep, find, ls, analyze) with undo store and CRLF/BOM preservation. |
| `mehh-coding-agent` | `lib.rs` (modules: agent_session, auth, compaction, interactive, lead_worker, mcp_manager, modes, permissions, rpc, session, settings, skills, subagent, system_prompt, todo, trust, etc.) | Full coding agent session orchestration: session management (JSONL v3 with branching/compaction), auth, system prompt building, subagents, permissions, trust, MCP integration. |
| `mehh-tui` | `lib.rs` (modules: ansi, components, fuzzy, keys, theme, tui, wheel_scroll) | Terminal UI rendering: ANSI stripping, text wrapping, fuzzy filtering, keybindings, themes, markdown view, editor component. |
| `mehh-mcp` | `lib.rs` (modules: client, config, jsonrpc, oauth, tool_adapter, transport) | Model Context Protocol implementation: JSON-RPC framing, stdio/HTTP transports, MCP client, config loading, AgentTool adapters. |
| `mehh-codemode` | `lib.rs` (modules: sandbox, tool) | QuickJS sandbox execution of user JS code with tool calling, KV store persistence, timeouts, output capture. |
| `mehh-execpolicy` | `lib.rs` | Shell-aware permission policy evaluation: command prefix matching, verdict computation (Allow/Prompt/Deny), dangerous prefix detection, safe rule prefix extraction. |
| `mehh-sandbox` | `lib.rs` | Kernel-level sandbox planning: bwrap (Linux), seatbelt (macOS), path protection, secret env scrubbing, violation detection. Reports degraded status when no backend available. |
| `mehh-cli` | `main.rs` | CLI entry point: clap arg parsing, session resolution, model/provider resolution, MCP connection, interactive/print/RPC modes, tool selection. |

---

## 4. TypeScript ↔ Rust Relationship

**Separate implementations with behavioral parity goal**, not FFI or shared code:

- The `packages/` (TS) directory is **absent** from this checkout; it lives in a separate reference checkout (`karmavn/Mehhcode@ts-reference`).
- Rust crates under `crates/` are **ports** of the TS packages. Porting is guided by a `ts-to-rust-parity` skill doc requiring "behavioral and caller parity, not just core happy paths."
- No FFI between TS and Rust — they are independent implementations. Rust source files carry comments like `// ported from TypeScript packages/tui/src/fuzzy.ts` to trace provenance.
- Shared contracts: AGENTS.md instructs to grep callers across both `packages/` and `crates/` when changing shared signatures.

---

## 5. Test Directories & Setup

Test locations found:

| Path | Crate | Framework |
|------|-------|-----------|
| `crates/mehh-tools/tests/test_analyze.rs` | mehh-tools | Rust `#[cfg(test)]` / integration tests |
| `crates/mehh-mcp/tests/test_annotations.rs` | mehh-mcp | Integration tests (mock transport) |
| `crates/mehh-coding-agent/tests/*.rs` (17 files) | mehh-coding-agent | Integration tests (session governance, approval gate, permissions, subagents, tool inspection, etc.) |
| `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` inline in each crate's `src/lib.rs` | All crates | Unit tests within library source |

- Rust tests use `#[tokio::test]` for async, standard `assert!`/`assert_eq!`, and `TempTestDir` helper patterns for temp directory cleanup.
- AGENTS.md specifies Rust commands: `cargo check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test -p <crate>`.
- TS tests (not runnable here due to absent `node_modules`): Vitest for `packages/*` (except tui), `node --test` for `packages/tui`.

---

## 6. Git Status & Recent Activity

**Git commands could not be executed** (no shell execution tool available). However, based on available evidence:

- The `.git/` directory exists at the repo root with standard structure (`HEAD`, `refs/`, `objects/`, `index`, etc.).
- The AGENTS.md and documentation reference recent activity including design specs dated `2026-11-13` through `2026-11-22` (strongest-rust-agent-design, ts-parity-waves-4-5-6, goose-parity-core, tui-ux-optimization, coding-agent-gap-design), suggesting active development in late November 2026.
- The `target/` directory exists (cargo build artifacts present).
- `docs/handoff/gemini-coding-agent-gaps/` contains extensive handoff documentation, indicating this is a porting/migration project from a TypeScript reference to Rust.

---

### Workspace Manifest

`Cargo.toml` at root defines a workspace with 10 members:
```
crates/mehh-ai, mehh-agent, mehh-tools, mehh-coding-agent, mehh-tui,
mehh-mcp, mehh-codemode, mehh-execpolicy, mehh-sandbox, mehh-cli
```
All at version `0.1.0`, edition 2021, MIT license. Shared dependencies include tokio, reqwest, serde, clap, crossterm, tracing, thiserror, anyhow, uuid, base64, sha2, regex, globset, ignore, similar.
